message: 早すぎ

name: Sally
message: 「Fwaaah. Mornin', Prez!」

name: Synn
message: 「Morning.」

name: Sally
message: 「You're up early today!」

name: Sally
message: 「Ooh! Daikon miso soup! Looks yummy!」

name: Synn
message: 「It'll be ready soon, so go call Azel too.」

name: Sally
message: 「Roger that! Leave it to me!」

name: Paqy
message: 「You're the landlord, Synn-sama, so why don'tcha just use the spare key and barge into Azel's room?」

name: Synn
message: 「I can't very well do that.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Give 'er a good-morning kiss or somethin'. Might as well push 'er down while you're at it.」

name: Synn
message: 「Wh-What are you saying first thing in the morning!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Bit late to act shy now after splashin' your load all over 'er like that.」

name: Synn
message: 「O-Ow!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Here ya go. A bandage. A cute one with my awesome mark on it.」

name: Synn
message: 「Thanks... wait, you were watching!?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Yours was huge for a guy with a face like yours, Synn-sama.」

name: Sally
message: 「What was huge?」

name: Synn
message: 「N-N-Nothing! Where's Azel?」

name: Sally
message: 「Doesn't look like she's here. Her shoes weren't at the entrance either.」

name: Synn
message: 「Whaaat!?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hey! You!」

name: Synn
message: 「A-A sudden headlock!? Gwaaah, I give, I give!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Azel hasn't shown up the day before yesterday, yesterday, or today! What's the big idea!」

name: Synn
message: 「Give, give, give up.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Jealousy sure is scary~」

name: Eddie
message: 「Hasn't the match already been decided?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「It was a long dry spell, so it's not that easy to sort out her feelings~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You guys! Don't look at me with pity in your eyes!」

name: Synn
message: 「Phew...」

name: Synn
message: 「Azel is just running around taking photos.」
Probably.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Look, you're supposedly the Student Council president and her landlord, so tell her to show up to class.」

name: Synn
message: 「I think so too, but I haven't been able to see Azel for the past three days.」

name: Nanaka & Sacchin
message: 「Three days!?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah. Just bad timing. That's all it is.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Don't brush it off as bad timing! You must've done something to make her avoid you!」

name: Synn
message: 「Like I said, Azel isn't really avoiding me or anything--」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Dense idiot.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Total dense idiot~」

name: Paqy
message: 「What a big shot.」

name: Eddie
message: 「Synn. I get it. You made a blunder you can't tell the girls about, didn't you?」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」
Eddy patted my shoulder in a friendly way and whispered.

name: Eddie
message: 「Be honest, you were too quick, right?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「So the President was too quick, wasn't he.」

name: Misa
message: 「W-What are you saying, Lolotte!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You're on Eddy's level.」

name: Sally
message: 「What does 'too fast' mean?」

name: Ria
message: 「I bet when Synn made ramen for Azel, he didn't boil the noodles long enough.」

name: Sally
message: 「Ooh. That's the worst. If someone made me eat gross ramen like that, I wouldn't even want to look at their face. We're through!」

name: Paqy
message: 「That's just you.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Senpai-san, 'fast' doesn't mean that. If you're too premature, things go rotten. That's why men leave women utterly exasperated.」

name: Sally
message: 「What goes rotten? I don't want yummy food going rotten.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「You really are clueless, Omake-san. When it comes to men and women going rotten, it's obviously the man.」

name: Sally
message: 「Prez is rotten?! Well, he doesn't look tasty anyway, so whatever.」

name: Synn
message: 「That's harsh.」

name: Ria
message: 「Synn, there are only 11 days left until the Holy Night Festival, so does Azel still have a lot of photos left to take?」

name: Synn
message: 「No, when I transferred the files four mornings ago, she was down to about 10 people.」

name: Misa
message: 「...Sakura-kun, you have zero sense of crisis.」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-You think so?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Sigh... Synn, you really are dense in every single way.」

name: Misa
message: 「Listen to me. She's making up forced excuses to avoid even meeting with you, right? Realize that something is going on!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「In fact, get it through your head!」

name: Synn
message: 「Could it be... that Azel's been avoiding me for the past few days? For real?」

name: Everyone
message: 「Don't just notice that now!」
